d: Join Qiddiya Investment Company as a Commercial Director - Commercial and Reporting, where your expertise will play a key role in driving the financial performance and strategic direction of our groundbreaking projects. In this position, you will lead the commercial and reporting aspects of our initiatives, focusing on providing critical insights that optimize our operational effectiveness and align with our business objectives.
q: li
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA is preferred
li
At least 15 years of experience in commercial management and financial reporting within the Construction or Development sectors
li
Proven experience in developing commercial strategies and leading financial reporting initiatives
li
Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making
li
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage effectively with stakeholders
li
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
li
Proficient in financial management software and ERP systems
li
Adept at team leadership and fostering professional growth within team members
r: li
Develop and implement comprehensive commercial strategies to drive revenue growth and maximize profitability for all projects
li
Oversee the preparation of detailed financial reports, forecasting, and performance analysis to support decision-making
li
Collaborate with finance and project management teams to ensure accurate budgeting, cost control, and financial management
li
Establish and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor project and operational performance effectively
li
Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies across all commercial activities
li
Conduct market analysis to identify opportunities for revenue generation and cost savings
li
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders and partners to enhance collaboration and support business interests
li
Lead and mentor the commercial reporting team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement

d: Scale’s rapidly growing Global Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of:
Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens
Generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs
Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI

As a Full Stack Software Engineer (Forward Deployed), you’ll collaborate directly with public sector counterparts to quickly build full-stack, AI applications, to solve their most pressing challenges and achieve meaningful impact for citizens.

At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions - we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you.
Collaborate with senior engineers to implement features for public sector clients, including spending time with the client to understand user feedback and assist with delivery.
Develop and maintain full-stack components that integrate with AI models, focusing on building responsive UIs and reliable backend APIs.
Assist in deploying and monitoring applications within cloud environments, ensuring basic system stability and security.
Help build and refine reusable features that support diverse international client use cases.
Work within a multi-disciplinary team of design, product, and data specialists to build robust features that follow established technical architectures.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related quantitative field

Professional full-stack experience with a focus on React, TypeScript, and Python/Node.js. Familiarity with Next.js and NoSQL/Relational databases, along with exposure to containerization (Docker) and cloud deployments.
Experience building and deploying web applications with a good understanding of cloud fundamentals and scalable coding practices.
A self-starting approach to navigate ambiguous requirements and deliver reliable software.
Experience working cross functionally with operations
PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.

At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.

The role will provide specialist geotechnical expertise for marine and coastal developments such as reclamation works, breakwaters, quay walls, ports, harbors, jetties and related structures in Oman. Responsibilities include field investigations, analytical design, construction support and close coordination with multidisciplinary project teams to ensure safe, cost‑effective delivery of complex maritime infrastructure.
q: li
BSc/MSc in Civil or Geotechnical Engineering.
li
Minimum 10 years of experience in marine/coastal geotechnical engineering.
li
Proven track record on reclamation, breakwater, port and harbor projects.
li
Proficiency with geotechnical software (e.g., Plaxis, GeoStudio, FLAC).
li
Knowledge of Omani and international geotechnical design codes and standards.
li
Strong technical report writing and presentation skills.
li
Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary project teams.
li
Fluent English (Arabic language skills are a plus).
li
Willingness to travel to project sites in Oman as required.
li
Professional Engineer registration (PE, UAE, Oman) preferred.
r: li
Plan and execute marine and coastal site investigations (boreholes, CPT, sampling, in‑situ testing).
li
Perform geotechnical analyses and design for reclamation, breakwaters, quay walls, ports, jetties and associated structures.
li
Prepare detailed geotechnical reports, design calculations, and technical specifications.
li
Review and comment on design packages submitted by consultants and internal teams.
li
Provide on‑site construction support, including monitoring, troubleshooting and design modifications.
li
Coordinate with structural, hydraulic, environmental and other discipline engineers to integrate geotechnical solutions.
li
Ensure compliance with Omani regulations, international codes and WSP quality standards.
li
Maintain and manage geotechnical data, databases and project documentation.
li
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to knowledge‑sharing within the team.
li
Assist in business development activities, proposal preparation and client presentations.
